winner.why: A clean frame of the hovering bird model from the film with one number the title does not repeat. The title names the cause; the cover shows the subject. Honest: the picture is the film's own code-drawn bird, and the wings really do slow to five beats a second at ten times slower.

chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a hummingbird hovering beside a window feeder, one wing a crisp shape and the other a fan of faint ghost copies. Composition: centre-left, large, side profile, negative space above. Lighting and treatment: soft daylight from the window, cool sky behind; palette cream #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, cobalt #2F5BFF; shallow depth of field, clean exact surfaces. Mood: wonder. Text: '50' very large in blue (#1F3BD1) above 'beats a second' in bold ink, lower left. Scientific accuracy: hummingbird wings beat about fifty times a second; the model wing sweeps forward, flips and sweeps back. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news photo. Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25%.
